banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.message: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalised content, and analyse our traffic. By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies.

categories.name: Necessary
categories.description: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

cookies.name: cookieyes-consent
cookies.description: Stores the user's cookie consent preferences.

categories.name: Functional
categories.description: Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing content on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

categories.name: Analytics
categories.description: Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website, helping us improve our site and services.

cookies.name: _ga
cookies.description: Registers a unique ID for statistical purposes (Google Analytics).

cookies.name: _gid
cookies.description: Registers a unique ID to generate statistical data on visitor usage.

categories.name: Performance
categories.description: Performance cookies are used to understand and analyse key performance indexes of the website, improving visitor experience.

cookies.name: perf_data
cookies.description: Used to track page load performance.

categories.name: Advertisement
categories.description: Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with relevant ads and marketing campaigns, tracking visitors across websites.

cookies.name: _fbp
cookies.description: Used by Facebook to deliver advertisements.
